<infobox theme="starship">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="designer"><label>Designer</label></data>	
        <data source="manufacturer"><label>Manufacturer</label></data>
        <data source="line"><label>Line</label></data>	
        <data source="model"><label>Model</label></data>	
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>	
        <data source="cost"><label>Cost</label></data>	
        <data source="modifier"><label>Modifier</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Technical specifications</header>
        <data source="sysmods"><label>Modified systems</label></data>	
        <data source="length"><label>Length</label></data>	
        <data source="width"><label>Width</label></data>	
        <data source="height"><label>Height/depth</label></data>	
        <data source="mass"><label>Mass</label></data>	
        <data source="max accel"><label>Maximum acceleration</label></data>        
        <data source="speed"><label>Maximum speed</label></data>	
        <data source="velocity"><label>Maximum velocity</label></data>	
        <data source="engine"><label>Engine unit(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="poweroutput"><label>Power output</label></data>	
        <data source="power"><label>Power plant</label></data>	
        <data source="shield gen"><label>Shielding</label></data>	
        <data source="hull"><label>Hull</label></data>	
        <data source="sensor"><label>Sensor systems</label></data>
        <data source="target"><label>Targeting systems</label></data>	
		<data source="navigation"><label>Navigation system</label></data>	
        <data source="avionics"><label>Avionics</label></data>	
        <data source="maincomp"><label>Main computer</label></data>	
        <data source="countermeasures"><label>Countermeasures</label></data>	
        <data source="armament"><label>Armament</label></data>        
        <data source="complement"><label>Complement</label></data>
        <data source="crew"><label>Crew</label></data>
        <data source="skeleton"><label>Minimum crew</label></data>	
        <data source="passengers"><label>Passengers</label></data>	
        <data source="capacity"><label>Cargo capacity</label></data>
        <data source="cargohandling"><label>Cargo handling systems</label></data>
        <data source="communications"><label>Communication systems</label></data>	
        <data source="othersystems"><label>Other systems</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
        <header>Usage</header>
        <data source="role"><label>Role(s)</label></data>
        <data source="firstuse"><label>Year introduced</label></data>
		<data source="destroyed"><label>Destroyed</label></data>
        <data source="retired"><label>Retired</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
		<data source="owners"><label>Owner(s)</label></data>	
		<data source="captains"><label>Commander(s)</label></data>
		<data source="registry"><label>Registration number(s)</label></data>	
		<data source="aliases"><label>Aliases</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:IndividualVehicle|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>

==Purpose==
This infobox is utilized for non-specified individual vehicles.
